svg.desc: A recorded experience is already memory. An agent, or an optional configured host worker, proposes a conditional lesson linked to that evidence. It is saved as a candidate and excluded from normal recall. On later tasks, an agent explicitly calls brain_trial, tests the method and reports the result through brain_feedback. Brain activates it after helpful reports from two fresh tasks with distinct evidence. Until then it remains a candidate. Harmful feedback retires a candidate or active lesson. Active lessons may return in normal recall on a later prompt. The Brain enforces evidence rules but does not independently verify reports, train the model, or publish skills.
svg.title: How a result becomes reusable knowledge

g.text: How a result becomes reusable knowledge
“Knowledge” here means a tested lesson, with conditions and evidence.
From brain_record: a result with source evidence.
It is already memory. It is not yet a reusable lesson.
An agent calls brain_propose, or a configured
host worker drafts a lesson from saved results.
Includes when it applies + source record links.
C Agent tests it on a new task
brain_trial → apply the method → check outcome
Source tasks and reused evidence do not count.
Until both helpful tests qualify, it stays a candidate.
Two helpful fresh tasks + distinct evidence.
The agent still checks conditions and current facts.
Harmful feedback can retire an active lesson too.
Brain checks the evidence rules. It does not independently verify reported outcomes.
These are external records, not model training or automatic changes to skills.
